item.title: Weekly Wrap: Market Higher For A Second Week
item.description: Australian shares were up slightly for a second week on Friday with investors hoping for an interest rate cut in the US, even as the chances of a local cut have evaporated. With the US Fed and the local Reserve Bank both meeting this week to decide on official interest rates, there are still strong hopes the US will cut rate even though still strong Australian inflation have greatly reduced the chances of any cut here.

item.title: The Key to Retiring with Confidence
item.description: How much do you really need to retire? It is a question that puzzles many, and yet the answer reminds as elusive as ever.

item.title: NoviqTech Partners with Eco-Markets Australia and The Hashgraph Group for Environmental Credit Platform
item.description: NoviqTech (ASX: NVQ) has received grant funding from the Hashgraph Association to deliver Eco-Markets Australia’s Registry 2.0, a modernised environmental credit registry supporting programs such as the Reef Credit Scheme.

item.title: Chalice Mining PFS Confirms Gonneville as Long-Life Globally Competitive Critical Minerals Development
item.description: A pre-feasibility study for Chalice Mining’s (ASX: CHN) greenfield Gonneville project in Western Australia has confirmed a long-life, globally competitive critical minerals development set to generate $4.7 billion in free cash flow.

item.title: NH3 Clean Energy and ITOCHU to Develop Green Shipping and Bunkering Operations in Asia-Pacific Region
item.description: NH3 Clean Energy (ASX: NH3) will supply product from its flagship WAH2 ammonia project in Western Australia to Japan’s ITOCHU Corporation for the development of ammonia-fuelled shipping and bunkering operations in the Asia-Pacific region.

item.title: Great Divide Mining to 100%-Acquire Challenger Mine from Adelong Gold in Wake of Dispute Resolution
item.description: Great Divide Mining (ASX: GDM) has resolved a dispute that had halted operations at the Challenger gold mine in NSW, with a new agreement clearing the way for it to acquire the remaining 49% interest in the mine from Adelong Gold (ASX: ADG).

item.title: Artrya Secures Second US Commercial Order for Salix SaaS Platform to Manage Coronary Artery Disease
item.description: Artrya (ASX: AYA) has signed a commercial agreement with US-based Northeast Georgia Health System for the use of its Salix AI cloud platform for point-of-care assessment and management of coronary artery disease.

item.title: Andean Silver Raises $30m to Accelerate Resource Conversion at Cerro Bayo Project in Chile
item.description: Andean Silver (ASX: ASL) has received strong support for a $30 million placement priced at A$1.85 per share to accelerate exploration at its Cerro Bayo silver-gold project in Chile.

item.title: Critical Resources Engages Canadian Government Relations Firm to Accelerate Mavis Lake Lithium Project
item.description: Critical Resources (ASX: CRR) has appointed leading Canadian government relations adviser Pathway Group to help advance permitting, funding access, and stakeholder engagement for its Mavis Lake Lithium Project in Ontario.

item.title: Terra Metals Intercepts Multiple Reefs and Sulfide Zones in Drilling at Dante’s Southwest SW1 Target
item.description: Terra Metals (ASX: TM1) has intercepted multiple reefs and magmatic sulfides in reverse circulation drilling at the Southwest prospect’s SW1 target within the company’s Dante multi-metal project in Western Australia.
